name: Jaiprakash Power Ventures Ltd.
reason: Thermal/hydro power generator from the distressed Jaypee group with losses in 5 of 11 years (EPS INR -4.11 in 2016 to 0.49 in 2025), 10y avg ROIC -0.5% and shares growing 11.8%/yr via debt-to-equity conversion; fails on economics and governance.

name: Nuvoco Vistas Corp. Ltd.
reason: Regional cement producer with EBIT margin 0.7-10.7% (now 89th pctile), 10y avg ROIC 0.9%, net debt/EBITDA 2.75x and acquisition-led growth (acq/FCF 1.22); commodity-cyclical with no specialness.

name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd.
reason: Lead-acid battery maker facing a credible EV/lithium technology shift: adjusted EPS INR 49.47 (2023) to 39.11 (2025), 5y EPS CAGR 0.7% and EBIT margin compressed from 14.9% to 6.2% (9th pctile) while it spends heavily on lithium-cell capex.

name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd.
reason: Sponge iron/ferro-alloy/pellet producer whose EPS (INR 0.42 in 2015 to 31.38 in 2025) is set by steel and ferro-alloy prices, now at its 10y high with EBIT margin 25.7% at the 91st pctile; commodity earner near a cyclical peak.

name: Wipro Ltd.
reason: IT services laggard with adjusted EPS CAGR of 6.6% (INR 6.77 to 12.80 over 2015-25) helped by buybacks, consensus FY1-FY3 only +3.2%/+3.3%/+7.1% (LTG ~4%) and AI disintermediation risk; cheap but no route to >=7% and no specialness.

name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd.
reason: Zinc/lead/silver miner whose EPS (INR 24.88 in 2022 to 18.36 in 2023 to 32.69 in 2025, a 10y high) is set by metal prices, controlled by the levered Vedanta group that extracts large special dividends; commodity earner fails forecastability.

name: AWL Agri Business Ltd.
reason: Edible-oil processor (Fortune) with 2.4% EBIT margin (10y max 4.1%), EPS down 74.6% in 2023 on palm/soy oil price swings and FY2025 EPS INR 8.05 below 2024's 9.43; commodity-spread economics with a promoter exit underway.

name: Grasim Industries Ltd.
reason: Aditya Birla holding conglomerate (VSF, chemicals, UltraTech cement, paints start-up, financial services) with adjusted EPS INR 65.48 (2016) to 6.22 (2025), 10y avg ROIC 4.0%, consolidated net debt/EBITDA 4.6x and a 58x NTM P/E; too complex and capital-hungry.

name: Hindustan Petroleum Corp. Ltd.
reason: State-controlled refiner/marketer whose adjusted EPS swung from INR -42.17 (2022) to 69.05 (2023) to 80.72 (2025) on refining/marketing margins and government fuel-pricing policy; EBIT margin 5.6% is at the 100th pctile and consensus FY1 is -101%.

name: Sanofi India Ltd.
reason: Sanofi's Indian subsidiary with 10y revenue CAGR of -1.7% after portfolio/consumer divestments, adjusted EPS flat at INR 149-156 over 2023-25, consensus FY2/FY3 +1.6%/-1.6% and EBIT margin 25.6% at the 91st pctile; no growth route and parent-dictated portfolio.

name: Bayer Cropscience Ltd.
reason: Solid agrochemical franchise (10y avg ROIC 20.7%, net cash) but adjusted EPS CAGR only 5.7% (INR 87.93 to 152.74 over 2015-25) with monsoon- and channel-inventory-driven swings (-23.8% in 2024) and parent-controlled product pipeline; consensus +10-13% is not reliably forecastable.

name: Pfizer Ltd. (India)
reason: Pfizer's Indian subsidiary whose adjusted EPS rose 12%/yr (INR 52.96 to 163.93) mostly via margin expansion to a 100th-pctile 34.3% EBIT margin on just 2.3%/yr revenue growth; price-control (NLEM) exposure and parent portfolio decisions leave no >=7% organic route.

name: Infosys Ltd.
reason: High-quality IT services leader (10y avg ROIC 26.4%, net cash, adjusted EPS INR 29.77 to 75.40, 9.7% CAGR) but consensus FY1-FY3 is only +1.8%/+4.2%/+5.0% (LTG 5.1%) and generative-AI disruption of labour-based services cannot be forecast 5-10 years out.

name: Coal India Ltd.
reason: State-controlled coal monopoly whose EPS (INR 15.55 in 2016 to 58.84 in 2023 to 50.81 in 2025) is set by e-auction coal prices and government pricing/dividend policy, with long-run energy-transition risk; consensus LTG 4.5%.

name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd.
reason: BPO provider with adjusted EPS INR 4.00 to 10.25 (9.9% CAGR) and consensus +21-28%, but growth is partly acquisition-funded (acq/FCF 0.36, net debt/EBITDA 1.6x) in RPSG-group hands and call-centre/collections work faces direct AI-automation risk.

name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd.
reason: Recently listed (Dec-2024) luxury hotel and office-park owner with only 5 years of data, acquisition-led growth (acq/FCF 1.33), EBIT margin down from 54.0% to 32.6% and a -45% adjusted-vs-GAAP gap; asset-heavy, cyclical, not special.

name: Indian Oil Corp. Ltd.
reason: State-controlled refiner/marketer with EPS swinging INR 30.30 (2023) to 9.87 (2024) to 30.57 (2025) on refining margins and government fuel-pricing; EBIT margin 8.1% at 91st pctile and consensus FY1 -71%.

name: Jindal Stainless Ltd.
reason: Stainless-steel producer whose EPS (INR 1.40 in 2019 to 39.20 in 2025, a 10y high) and 91st-pctile EBIT margin of 10.3% follow nickel/steel spreads and anti-dumping protection, with shares up 5.5%/yr from mergers; commodity earner near a cyclical peak.

name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd.
reason: Dominant power exchange with superb economics (82% EBIT margin, 10y ROIC 44%, EPS INR 1.03 to 5.54, up >=7% in 9/10 years) but CERC-mandated market coupling threatens its day-ahead share and pricing power; consensus FY2/FY3 only +0.6%/+5.1% with margin at 100th pctile.
